name: use-family
description: The whole *-use family in one install: browser, email, texts (iMessage/SMS), chat, phone, Nintendo Switch, identity, passwords, sessions, notes, clipboard history, how this Mac is doing, promo and explainer videos, the other agents on your machines, and multi-agent workflows across them. Adds a routing skill that tells the agent which use to reach for and how they combine, the `use` upgrade command (via use-manager), plus a session-start check for missing CLIs and one that upgrades a CLI older than its plugin.
